constant_position: Quarantine all-14-channel constant qpos; not individual stationary joints or zero effort placeholders
duplicate_rule: Keep lowest original episode index only when all three published RGB SHA-256 hashes and all actual measured sensor arrays agree; preserve raw files
grouping_rule: Canonical task IDs, transitively combined across exact sensor or video duplicate components
human_rule: Exclude native human-intervention category for explicitly restricted primary acquisition cohort; report inclusive sensor cohort separately. This rule uses native outcome-derived metadata and is not label-blind human detection.
B02: Retain native label in dataset; locked visual judgment remains uncertain; do not exclude a valid native episode because a sparse reviewer abstains
video_rule: Full release RGB identity/file-presence audit uses pinned publisher inventory. Only previously decoded pilot media are payload-verified. Never mark the entire visual cohort training-ready based on inventory presence.
split_rule: Five outer task-disjoint folds; four inner task-disjoint folds; hash-ordered identities with seed20261029, no class-label balancing
